portraitAlt: Portrait of Simran in a blue silk saree
intro: Actor, producer and director across Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada cinema — known for her dance and for performances that have spanned three decades.

timeline.text: Debut, and the decade that made her a household name across the South.
Vaaranam Aayiram in 2008 brought the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress; in 2015 she and Deepak Bagga set up their studio, Simran & Sons.
Paava Kadhaigal, Andhagan, Tourist Family — and Dharman, now shooting.
